name: Hours of nothing fade an excited Boop a step at a time
case: Boop is excited when a quick turn finishes, and then nothing happens for hours. Each hour of nothing fades its mood one step toward calm: to happy after the first (excited has no move straight to calm), then calm after the second.
why: characters/boop/steering/guide.md: after an hour of nothing a mood fades a step toward calm; the mood graph has no move from excited to calm, so it goes through happy (characters/boop/steering/mood/excited.md)
